nodes.title: START HERE — clean DiffusionGemma + LTX-2.5 Image-to-Video
widgets_values:
# Clean DiffusionGemma → LTX-2.5 Image-to-Video

1. Replace **First-frame image** and edit the **Creative brief**. The same image is already connected to the Director Context Hub and native LTX first-frame conditioning.
2. Leave Context Hub **video** and **last_frame_image** empty. Auto mode will resolve this graph to **Image to video**.
3. The shared duration controls both Director planning and LTX generation. On **Node 7**, choose the output aspect ratio and megapixel target; the 16:9 / 0.5 MP baseline drives native LTX at **960×544**. Increase resolution only after a clean baseline render.
4. The native LTX prompt enhancer is off. DiffusionGemma's gated positive prompt and generated negative prompt feed LTX directly.
5. Grounding starts in **audit** mode for a faster first test. Switch it to **strict** after the baseline works.

This workflow intentionally contains no MiniMax-H3 Reference Context, Ref2VA manifest, H3 target profile, or H3 sampler nodes.

Candidate prompt previews are diagnostic only: they update even when validation blocks a render. Native LTX receives the positive prompt through the standard fail-closed Generation Gate and the negative prompt directly from the fail-closed Splitter output; never route a candidate socket directly to the generator. Refresh recomputes but does not randomize a fixed Director seed.

nodes.title: 1. Creative brief — describe motion from the supplied frame
widgets_values: Create a five-second continuous live-action shot grounded in the supplied first frame. Preserve the officer's identity, uniform, roadside setting, daylight, and opening composition. He shifts his weight, turns his attention toward something just off-camera, and takes one measured step as a light breeze moves his hair and clothing. Use one subtle stabilized camera push with no cuts, no new people, and no change of location. Natural roadside ambience and soft clothing movement are heard; no dialogue or intelligible speech.

subgraphs.name: Image to Video (LTX-2.5, DiffusionGemma prompts)

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: Egyptian royal in blue-and-gold headdress and high collar, white dress with golden embroidery and armbands, desert, robot soldiers in formation left and right. She walks steadily forward, head held level and gaze fixed ahead—no dipping or lowering of the head. The camera performs a single, smooth push-in only: starting in a wider shot of her, the robots, and the desert, it moves steadily forward until she is in a medium or medium-close frame, then holds. She stops, posture and head still upright, and says: “The old gods are silent. I am not.” Robot soldiers shift or march in place; sand and fabric move with the wind. No pull-back; the only camera move is the continuous push-in.

subgraphs.description: Native two-stage LTX-2.5 I2V with external DiffusionGemma positive and negative prompts; built-in prompt enhancement remains off.
